title: The Rough Monsoon
author: Marguerite Voss
blurb: Vesper Pemberton, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
